node.statement: Exact hypothesis audit: lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion requires epsilon <= t <= e_0. Node 1.2.1 proves epsilon=t, 0 <= t <= W.r_reset, and epsilon<=t. Lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger bounds W.K_call*epsilon only by W.r_reset,e_sim,e_full, not by e_0. Lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger states its raw-call conclusions under the respective producer hypotheses, so it preserves the t<=e_0 requirement and does not discharge it. Therefore no allowed premise implies t<=e_0; the former unconditional application is invalid and can be repaired only by an exported bound such as W.r_reset<=e_0 (or epsilon<=e_0), or by adding t<=e_0 as a premise.
